title: The Crushed Tile
crime: During chemistry lab a heavy crate was dropped, cracking a floor tile. Each student claimed the pressure their crate exerted, and one lied.
deed: you dropped your crate on the tile, cracked it, then reported a false pressure.
oath: My crate presses on the floor at {value} Pa. Check the gauge.
measure: The lab measures each crate's force and contact area with the sensor pad.
hint: *Pressure is force divided by area. Which number goes on top?
arrive: The lab floor is cracked; the pressure law is needed to catch the liar.
Three students each gave a pressure reading for their crate.
Question them, then compare to the sensor data.
inspect: Crate footprints show a heavy impact point.
Sensor logs list force and area for each crate; pressure reveals the false claim.
confession: Okay, I slammed my crate down, broke the tile, and gave a higher pressure than the data shows.
